messages:
marta: Quick follow-up to the ABI minimization RFC: propose a tiny feature-negotiator protocol (compact capability vector + version) so runtimes can adapt without full manifests. Pros: smaller wire, faster fallback. Cons: more adapter logic.
kevin: Major question = secrets/KMS. If adapters decide locally, who fetches keys?
sam: Telemetry concern: must tag traces with cap vector so regressions are visible.
marta: Plan: control-plane issues short-lived signed claim scoped to capabilities; adapter validates, then fetches secrets only when needed.
alex: Private deployments may need local signing (PKI bootstrap) or keep legacy manifest path. Long-term prefer PKI.
kevin: Ensure fallback enforces identical policy/quota.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: prototype canary planned 2025-10-12T22:00Z.
marta: Action items: sam=trace + bench, kevin=token schema + PKI draft, alex=tenant flag + fallback. I'll write RFC addendum. :thumbsup:
